Package index

Simulation files

Read an .apsimx file into a typed, round-trippable object, list its simulations, write it back, and apply validated node-path edits.

apsim_sim()
A simulation file (.apsimx) as a typed object
apsim_simulations()
List the simulation names in an apsim_sim
apsim_write()
Write an apsim_sim back to an .apsimx file
apsim_edit()
Apply [Node].Property = value edits through APSIM's validator

Run and predict

Drive the simulator over a scenario design and read its outputs as a contract-emitting ensemble.

apsim_predict()
Run APSIM forward over a simulation file
apsim_design()
Build an experimental design over an APSIM parameter space
apsim_read()
Read a report from an APSIM DataStore
apsim_reports()
List the report tables in an APSIM DataStore

Calibrate and estimate

Solve the inverse problem – a bounded point estimate or a posterior parameter ensemble – and fit a mechanism to a simulated input grid.

apsim_calibrate()
Calibrate APSIM parameters against observations
apsim_estimate()
Estimate a mechanism by running APSIM across an input

Sensitivity and emulation

Screen and decompose parameter influence (Morris, Sobol) and fit a Gaussian-process surrogate of an expensive output with leave-one-out diagnostics.

apsim_sensitivity()
Global sensitivity analysis of an APSIM output
apsim_emulate()
Emulate an expensive APSIM output with a Gaussian-process surrogate
apsim_forward_model()
Build an APSIM forward model

Validate

Score simulated output against observations with goodness-of-fit metrics and a typed verdict, and draw observed-versus-predicted.

apsim_validate()
Validate simulated output against observations
apsim_validation_plot()
Plot observed against predicted for a validation manifest

Causal ground truth (OSSE)

Turn the simulator into a known-causal-structure data factory: an observing-system simulation experiment with both potential outcomes known.

apsim_ground_truth()
Generate a known-causal-structure dataset from APSIM (an OSSE)

Contract manifest

The versioned, provenance-complete result object and its bridge to the ‘PESTO’ ensemble-manifest contract.

apsim_manifest()
An APSIM result as a contract-emitting manifest
as_pesto_manifest()
Bridge an apsim_manifest to a PESTO ensemble manifest
orchestra_manifest
The orchestra manifest contract (apsimR-side implementation)
as_orchestra_manifest()
Emit an apsimR result as an orchestra manifest
verify_manifest()
Verify an orchestra manifest's payload integrity
manifest_summary()
A typed home for a headline verdict

Runtime and abstention

Discover, configure and query the installed simulator; the typed refusal returned when the runtime is absent.

apsim_available()
Is the APSIM simulator available?
apsim_version()
Installed APSIM version string
apsim_configure()
Configure the APSIM runtime explicitly
apsim_example()
Path to an installed APSIM example simulation
apsim_server()
Start a persistent APSIM server holding a simulation in memory
apsim_run()
Run the server's in-memory simulation, optionally with modified parameters
apsim_output()
Read a report from the server after a run
apsim_abstention()
Construct a typed abstention
is_apsim_abstention()
Is an object an apsimR abstention?

External-fact grounding

The Independent-Oracle registry of the APSIM facts the package asserts and the date each was last diffed against a live install.

apsim_external_facts()
apsimR's external-authority (APSIM) fact registry
apsim_fact_status()
Grounding status summary for apsimR's external facts

apsimR apsimR-package
apsimR: APSIM Next Generation as a Contract-Emitting Analysis Member
